notes: FINAL V3 uses isolated output/checkpoint directories so older reserve-only or pre-PCC experiments cannot be accidentally mixed into the final corrected run.
The physical transformer/PCC safety layer constrains combined grid exchange plus outgoing sharing.
The local grid-violation term receives requested pre-projection PCC loading magnitude so projection does not erase local feasibility credit.
Step 7R-F starts from fresh SAC weights and replay buffers because pre-correction policies were trained under physically inconsistent reserve economics.
Upward reserve is constrained by unused BESS discharge-power headroom and energy available above minimum SOC.
A one-hour reserve-delivery duration is an explicit reconstruction choice because the recovered manuscript does not specify the ancillary-service duration.
Initial SOC is a reconstruction choice.
EV per-vehicle availability records are interface reconstruction records; the time-varying aggregate demand originates from the ACN-derived training profile.
EV simultaneous fraction is a reconstruction choice.
Pairwise sharing capacity is a reconstruction choice.
Lead-1 Phi is used as the scalar coordinator risk confidence at each rolling decision.
Full confidence-aware 24-hour forecast remains embedded in the 96-dimensional predictive state.
